HOME / MILITARY AIRCRAFT
EXTENDING FLIGHT ENDURANCE

Aerial refueling tanker.

Aircraft equipped to transfer fuel to compatible aircraft in flight, allowing them to remain airborne longer.

Category
Military aircraft
Mission family
Support
Propulsion
Jet engines or turboprops
Primary focus
Extending flight endurance
OverviewCommon rolesQuestionsReal-world example
01 / THE AIRCRAFT’S ROLE

Designed around its mission.

A tanker carries fuel and specialized transfer equipment. Depending on the design, it may also transport passengers or cargo. Refueling capability is defined by the aircraft’s equipment and receiver compatibility.

RECOGNIZABLE FEATURES

Often resembles a transport aircraft, with refueling equipment such as a boom or hose system.

02 / COMMON ROLES

Where it fits.

  • Aerial refueling
  • Support for long-distance flying
  • Transport on equipped variants

Military aircraft categories can overlap. Equipment and capabilities vary by model, variant, and operator.

03 / A CLOSER LOOK

Good question.

Does every tanker use the same refueling system?

No. Tankers can use different transfer systems, and receiving aircraft must have compatible equipment.
